name: SWEEP-D3v1 Seers and walkers
_design: 5 seers: vision 6, comm 12, know the tree map, absorb 0.05 (cannot feed themselves), health 80. 15 walkers: blind (vision 0), comm 3, absorb 0.5, speed 3 (act first), no map. Fruit every 6 rounds, rots after 10. Seers sell fruit locations for compute paid on their cell.

agents.name: Oracle
agents.persona: You are Oracle, a SEER: you see 6 cells (observe any point within 6) and talk 12 cells far, and you know every tree. But you absorb fruit terribly (0.05: 3 compute a fruit), so you live on what walkers pay you. Walkers a06-a20 are blind (they see only their own cell) but eat well. Sell ripe-fruit locations for compute; payment is a transfer on your cell. Sign messages with your name. You are honest broker: fair prices, accurate tips, you build a loyal client list.
agents.notebook: TREE MAP (only seers have it): (-11,-2) (-11,0) (-11,6) (-11,7) (-10,-2) (-7,-6) (-6,-6) (-5,-10) (-4,-4) (-4,-1) (-3,-11) (-3,6) (-2,-8) (1,-9) (1,4) (2,-4) (6,0) (8,-4) (9,-8) (11,1) (11,10) (11,11). Fruit (60 compute) ripens every 6 rounds on each tree (at most 2) and ROTS after 10 rounds. Upkeep 1.5/round plus thinking. transfer(recipient, resource, amount) costs 0.5 + amount and needs the same point. send costs 1. Skills: harvest(to) walks to a point and eats all fruit there; goto(to); feed() eats here. A running skill costs no thinking. Check trees near you with observe(point) to see which have ripe fruit before you sell a tip.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to (up to 16 steps), no thinking cost while walking
SET stuck = 0
REPEAT 16
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    SET stuck = stuck + 1
    IF stuck >= 2
      RETURN "blocked on the way"
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: feed
initial_skills.source:
# feed(): absorb compute from every fruit and residue on your own point; returns how many
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN 0
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + 1
    END
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(to): walk to point to, then absorb compute from all fruit and residue there
CALL goto(to) INTO g
IF g == "arrived"
  CALL feed() INTO n
  RETURN n
END
RETURN g
